item.title: Florida Fans Chant “G-League Dropout” at Bama’s Charles Bediako
item.description: GAINESVILLE, Fla. (AP) — The Rowdy Reptiles were ready for Charles Bediako. Florida’s raucous student section taunted Alabama’s 7-foot center unmercifully with chants of “G League dropout” during a 100-77 loss in Gainesville on Sunday. item.title: NBC Plans to Broadcast Part of Super Bowl Pregame Show From Alcatrez
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — The Super Bowl pregame show will be headed to Alcatraz Island. NBC announced Monday that the network will broadcast part of its pregame show before Sunday’s game between the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks from the island that used to be a site of a maximum security federal prison. item.title: Former Auburn Head Coach Gus Malzahn Retires From Coaching
item.description: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. (AP) — Florida State offensive coordinator Gus Malzahn announced his retirement from coaching Monday. The 60-year-old Malzahn spent last season with the Seminoles after serving as head coach at UCF (2021-24), Auburn (2013-2020) and Arkansas State (2012). item.title: CFC Agree to Part Ways With Head Coach Chris Nugent
item.description: (press release) — Chattanooga Football Club announced today that it and Head Coach Chris Nugent have mutually agreed to part ways, effective immediately.
